### Stack & Responsibilities
- Senior Software Engineer building Python AI-agent systems, scraping frameworks, and React interfaces. Improving Granicus cloud solutions that connect governments with residents.
Senior Software Engineer building AI-powered GovTech platforms at Granicus
- Tech stack: JavaScript, Microservices, Python, React, TypeScript
- Visa sponsorship signal: company profile says it sponsors H1B visas. Treat as a small scoring bonus, not a guarantee for this role.

- Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services using Python, FastAPI, and LangChain
- Build and maintain scraping frameworks using Firecrawl, Playwright, or similar technologies
- Develop and orchestrate multi-agent systems, including LangFlow pipelines and agent-to-agent communication
- Deploy multi-agent systems to production with robust monitoring and failover mechanisms
- Integrate agents with Salesforce, SharePoint, Slack, and internal business systems
- Create responsive, user-friendly frontend components using React.js or similar frameworks
- Implement real-time interfaces using SSE or WebSocket

- Hands-on experience with agent-based systems

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Senior Software Engineer building Python AI-agent systems, scraping frameworks, and React interfaces. Improving Granicus cloud solutions that connect governments with residents.
Senior Software Engineer building AI-powered GovTech platforms at Granicus
Role description:
• Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services using Python, FastAPI, and LangChain
• Build and maintain scraping frameworks using Firecrawl, Playwright, or similar technologies
• Develop and orchestrate multi-agent systems, including LangFlow pipelines and agent-to-agent communication
• Deploy multi-agent systems to production with robust monitoring and failover mechanisms
• Integrate agents with Salesforce, SharePoint, Slack, and internal business systems
• Create responsive, user-friendly frontend components using React.js or similar frameworks
• Implement real-time interfaces using SSE or WebSocket
• Monitor agent performance and interaction logs using observability platforms such as LangFuse
• Mentor junior developers and conduct code reviews
• Help drive system architecture decisions
• Collaborate with AI/ML, DevOps, and Product teams in agile environments
• Support Granicus information security, confidentiality, integrity, availability, and data privacy requirements
Role requirements:
• 8–12 years of full-stack development experience
• Expert-level Python proficiency
• Strong backend experience with FastAPI, asyncio, and scalable microservices
• Experience building and deploying web scraping frameworks such as Firecrawl, Scrapy, and Playwright
• Hands-on experience with agent-based systems
• Experience with agent-to-agent (A2A) communication
• Experience with LangFlow orchestration
• Experience deploying multi-agent systems in production
• Experience integrating agents with Salesforce, SharePoint, CRMs, or similar systems
• Frontend development experience using React.js, TypeScript, or other modern frameworks
• Familiarity with agent observability tools such as LangFuse
• Experience using developer AI tools such as GitHub Copilot, Winsurf, or equivalents
• Ability to meet Granicus information security and data privacy responsibilities
• No degree requirement stated; Granicus notes it does not have degree requirements for most roles
Benefits:
• Flexible Time Off
• Company-Wide Wellbeing Days (paid days off)
• Work From Home Reimbursement
• Private health, vision, dental and life insurance – 100% Employer-Paid
• On-Demand Mental Health Support, including Headspace and other wellness tools
• Pension Plan and Retirement options
• Online Learning Platforms
• Competitive Salary & Bonuses
• Employee Resource Groups
• Coffee with Mark sessions
• Microsoft Teams communities focused on wellness, art, furbabies, family, parenting, and more
• Special guest discussions on issues impacting employees
Tech stack:
JavaScript, Microservices, Python, React, TypeScript
